newsitem.title: USA: Resource stake held by Kramer Spellman.
newsitem.headline: Resource stake held by Kramer Spellman.

text.p: A group led by Kramer Spellman L.P. on Monday said it held a 7.98 percent stake, or 283,500 common shares, in Resource America Inc.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought the stake between November 27 and December 30 at prices ranging from $13 to $18.625 per share.
The group said it was holding the stake for investment purposes.
Resource America Inc of Philadelphia is engaged in oil and gas exploration and development, the operation of oil and gas wells and the management of oil and gas investment partnerships.
